name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $64,700 on 16 Nov, 25% below its 52-week high and 13% lower on the week; no stablecoin de-peg found
state: Bitcoin was near $64,655 at 05:41 UTC on 16 Nov, 25.3% below its 52-week high of $86,600, 12.6% lower on the week and 19.2% lower over a month (Yahoo Finance). Its worst day of the past five fell 6%. The drawdown sits just past the 25% Watch line; searches to 16 Nov found no major stablecoin de-peg or top-10 exchange failure.
for_you: Crypto prices are falling fast; holders face large swings. Stablecoins and major exchanges are operating normally as of 16 Nov.
why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
